violated_contract: Changed provider output is not sufficient evidence of a translation: a short target-language utterance misdetected as foreign can be rewritten in the same language, cached and persisted with a translated badge. An echoed source code is not independent language evidence.
canonical_prevention: Use the existing spoken-language profile and substantial conversation evidence as a reversible admission prior, then apply one conservative edit-aware output check to fresh results, cache replay and persistence. Keep synthetic short-English, genuine foreign, code-switched and high-overlap controls on the real coordinator and NLLB adapter path; expose bounded admission and rejection reasons without transcript content.
